_nameVariantsNote: Real spellings only: the canonical names, the ways the name is transliterated into Latin letters, the short form, and the handle he uses on LinkedIn, GitHub and YouTube. Emitted as schema.org alternateName and listed in llms.txt, llms-full.txt and api/profile.json, so a search or a model that meets any of them resolves to the same person. Listing them does not endorse them: profile.name stays canonical.
_nameMisspellingsNote: The family name written with the wrong first letter, which reads as a different Arabic word. People do type it, so it is listed for entity resolution, but it goes only into Person.alternateName in the JSON-LD, which no visitor reads. It must never reach visible text, llms.txt, llms-full.txt or the JSON API: the tests and validate enforce that.

tagline.en: I build React and TypeScript interfaces and the AI behind them: applications on large language models that take over manual work in Arabic and English.
tagline.ar: أبني واجهات React وTypeScript، والذكاء الاصطناعي الذي يعمل خلفها: تطبيقات قائمة على النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة تتولّى العمل اليدوي بالعربية والإنجليزية.

_imageNote: The portrait. 720×720, downscaled from me.png. Feeds Person.image in the structured data, the header avatar (via the 96px copy) and the full-size view behind it.

analytics._note: Google Analytics for nouraldeentofi.com, on the nourtofi42@gmail.com account. `tag` is the Google tag the pages load, exactly as Analytics gives it under Admin, Data streams, View tag instructions. `measurementId` is the web stream it reports to, kept for reference.

_ogImageNote: The 1200×630 share card, emitted as og:image / twitter:image so links unfurl with a real preview. Wider than the portrait and captioned, so it stays the share image rather than the photo. Made by `npm run og` from scripts/og/og.html, with its words taken from this file: never edit the PNG, and keep its name.
_updatedNote: The day the facts of his identity last changed: name, title, links, portrait, location. Set by hand, and only when one of those changes. It is the dateModified of the ProfilePage on the home page, so it must not move just because the site was rebuilt.

indexNow._note: IndexNow (indexnow.org) tells Bing, Yandex, Naver and Seznam that pages changed, with no account. The build writes <key>.txt at the site root, which proves the site owns the key; `npm run indexnow` then submits every address in the sitemap. The key is public by design.
